assertions.assertion: Adds or references the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration NuGet package
assertions.rationale: Shows the dotnet add package command and a .csproj PackageReference for Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddIdentityServerConfiguration() on the service collection
assertions.rationale: Explicitly calls builder.Services.AddIdentityServerConfiguration() in both the step and full Program.cs.

assertions.assertion: Calls MapDynamicClientRegistration() to map the DCR endpoint
assertions.rationale: Maps the endpoint with app.MapDynamicClientRegistration() in the pipeline.

assertions.assertion: Notes that MapDynamicClientRegistration() is an endpoint-routing call from the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration package, placed in the pipeline/endpoint routing (e.g. ConfigurePipeline) alongside UseIdentityServer()
assertions.rationale: States it is an endpoint-routing extension from the Configuration package and places it in the pipeline alongside UseIdentityServer().

assertions.assertion: Mentions that DCR requires Business Edition or higher license
assertions.rationale: Notes up front and in the summary that DCR requires a Business Edition or higher license and that Community Edition does not support it.

assertions.assertion: The MapDynamicClientRegistration() call includes RequireAuthorization() or the response warns about securing the endpoint
assertions.rationale: The mapped endpoint includes .RequireAuthorization("dcr") and the text warns never to expose it unauthenticated.
